title: LightRAG: Simple and Fast Retrieval-Augmented Generation
description: Integrates knowledge graph construction with RAG. Extracts entities and relationships from documents, builds a local-global knowledge graph, and retrieves at multiple granularities: entity-level, community-level (clusters), and global summaries. Dramatically improves RAG over large corpora where relationships between entities matter.
authors: Edge, Trinh, Cheng, Bradley, Chao, Mody, Truitt, Larson (Microsoft)
